task_definitions.description: Implement validation to check that required environment variables (NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID) are present before attempting API calls. Prevents runtime errors and provides clear feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Script checks for NOTION_API_KEY on startup
Script checks for NOTION_DATABASE_ID on startup
Clear error messages displayed if variables missing
Script exits gracefully if validation fails
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Add validation function at module initialization, before Notion client instantiation

task_definitions.description: Create a function to retrieve/query tasks from the Notion database. Should support fetching by task ID, status, or other properties.
acceptance_criteria: Function can retrieve task by page ID
Function can query tasks by status

task_definitions.description: Update createTask function to properly assign tasks to people. Currently passes empty array which doesn't utilize the assignedTo parameter.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be assigned to Notion users
Supports both user IDs and email addresses
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Notion API requires user IDs in specific format. May need user lookup functionality.

task_definitions.description: Enhance error handling throughout the application with specific error types, better error messages, and error recovery strategies.
acceptance_criteria: All async functions have try-catch blocks
Errors include context and actionable messages
Different error types handled appropriately (auth, network, validation)
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Consider creating custom error classes for different scenarios

task_definitions.description: Add structured logging to track operations, errors, and debug information. Replace console.log with proper logging framework.
acceptance_criteria: Different log levels implemented (info, warn, error, debug)
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Add winston or pino as dependency

task_definitions.description: Implement functionality to archive or delete tasks from the Notion database.
acceptance_criteria: Function can archive tasks (Notion's soft delete)
Proper error handling for non-existent tasks
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Use notion.pages.update() with archived: true property

task_definitions.description: Add advanced filtering capabilities to search and filter tasks by multiple criteria (status, assignee, date range, keywords).
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Use Notion database query filters API with compound conditions

task_definitions.description: Implement functions to perform bulk operations (create multiple tasks, update multiple tasks, batch status changes).
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Implement with Promise.all but respect Notion API rate limits (3 requests/second)

task_definitions.description: Extend task functionality to support due dates, including setting and updating due dates on tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be created with due dates
Support both date and datetime formats
Query tasks by due date range
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Requires adding Date property to Notion database schema or using existing date field

task_definitions.description: Implement task prioritization with priority levels (High, Medium, Low, Urgent).
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be created with priority
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Requires Priority select/multi-select property in Notion database

task_definitions.description: Build a command-line interface for interacting with the task manager without modifying code.
acceptance_criteria: CLI commands for create, read, update, delete operations
Interactive mode and command mode supported
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Use commander.js or yargs for CLI framework. Add chalk for colors.

task_definitions.description: Split single-file implementation into modular structure with separate files for different concerns (API client, task operations, utilities, CLI).
acceptance_criteria: Separate module for Notion client initialization
Separate module for task CRUD operations
No breaking changes to existing API
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Create lib/ directory structure. Maintain backward compatibility.

task_definitions.description: Create comprehensive unit test suite covering all functions with mocked Notion API calls.
Create integration tests that verify actual Notion API interaction with test database.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use real Notion API with test database
Can run independently or be skipped
Environment variable configuration for test database
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Requires separate test Notion database. Add to CI with secrets.

task_definitions.description: Write complete documentation including setup guide, API reference, usage examples, and troubleshooting.
task_definitions.implementation_notes: Include code examples and screenshots where appropriate

task_definitions.description: Set up continuous integration and deployment pipeline with automated testing, linting, and release process.
